picks.file: Aerial photograph of Ploiești from the west 01.jpg
picks.why: whole city seen from a plane, with its ring plan clear; dark window edge at right trimmed

notes: Taken through an airplane window, so colors are strong and slightly hazy, but it is the only usable picture. #2 and #3 are companion shots from the same flight; #4 (2009) shows countryside near the city, not the city.
